rows.label: Value of a dollar given as cash, the benchmark behind "multiples of cash" (units of value per dollar)

source.title: GiveWell cost-effectiveness analyses, "Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly"
source.note: 0.00335 in 142 of GiveWell's sheets imported here (0.003355 in its November 2024 GiveDirectly analysis, 'previous estimate for cash'). Low: Founders Pledge's 2022 GiveDirectly benchmark in units of value (1 / $164 per WELLBY-equivalent, 1.898 per doubling: 0.00321). High: GiveWell's November 2024 GiveDirectly estimate for Kenya, 0.00872.

rows.explainer:
What "1× cash" is worth. Evaluators state many results as multiples of cash transfers to GiveDirectly; the site turns every such multiple into units of value with this one figure, instead of each evaluator's own estimate of cash. It is GiveWell's long-standing benchmark, 0.00335 units of value per dollar (a doubled income for a year per $300), the figure GiveWell's multiples of cash are stated against.

Founders Pledge's 2022 benchmark comes to almost the same (0.0032). GiveWell's November 2024 update of GiveDirectly's own analysis is 2.6 times higher (0.0087, Kenya); it is the top of the range rather than the best guess because the multiples evaluators published were set against the older figure.
